mgmt_bio.text: Michael (Mike) Erickson, PhD, has served as President and Chief Executive Officer and a member of the board of directors of IDEXX Laboratories, Inc. Erickson joined IDEXX in 2011 and has held senior positions across diagnostics, software, strategy and corporate accounts, most recently as Executive Vice President and General Manager of IDEXX's Global Point of Care Diagnostics and Telemedicine lines of business from January 2024 to May 2026, and as a Senior Vice President from January 2020 to December 2023. Before IDEXX, he was an Associate Principal at McKinsey & Company, advising pharmaceutical and health service organizations.
